a.lede: The leap second will be replaced by a leap hour, which will take "several centuries" before it must be implemented.
a.title: Leap seconds being retired next year to avoid wreaking havoc on computer systems

b.lede: The metric might not mean much to laypeople, but leap seconds have been a source of contention in the timekeeping community for years. Now, they’re dead.
b.title: The Leap Second Is No More
